mapper.sql: cleanup_id, task_id, package_id, file_references_json, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, processing_token, lease_expires_time, last_error, version, created_time, updated_time
mapper.insert: insert into oa_sign_file_cleanup ( task_id, package_id, file_references_json, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, last_error, version, created_time, updated_time ) values ( #{taskId}, #{packageId}, #{fileReferencesJson}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{nextRetryTime}, #{lastError}, #{version}, sysdate(), sysdate() )
mapper.select: select from oa_sign_file_cleanup where cleanup_id = #{cleanupId} limit 1
mapper.update: update oa_sign_file_cleanup set status = 'COMPLETED', next_retry_time = null, processing_token = null, lease_expires_time = null, last_error = null, version = version + 1, updated_time = sysdate() where cleanup_id = #{cleanupId} and status = 'PROCESSING' and version = #{version} and processing_token = #{processingToken}

update oa_sign_file_cleanup set status = 'RETRY', retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, processing_token = null, lease_expires_time = null, last_error = #{lastError}, version = version + 1, updated_time = sysdate() where cleanup_id = #{cleanupId} and status = 'PROCESSING' and version = #{version} and processing_token = #{processingToken}
